privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: Bio-Dosha-12 stores your health-related information only to calculate body balance, give recommendations and help medical organizations keep patient records. This notice covers personal accounts, family profiles and the patient records of medical organizations.
privacy.collect: Account: name, email, a one-way hash of your password and your language. Profiles (yours and your family members', including children): birth date, sex, height, constitution type and Kt coefficient, weight, season, BEDI calculation history and recommendations. For medical organizations: the organization's name, type, registration number and contact details; patients' national register number, phone, address, intake cards, pulse examination, diagnosis, treatment plan and schedule. For security: your 2-step sign-in secret and a log of sign-ins and actions (IP address, browser).
privacy.use: The data is used only to calculate the BEDI index, deviation and recommendations, show history, produce intake cards and practitioner reports, verify organizations and protect accounts. It is never sold or used for advertising.
privacy.access: A personal account sees only its own profiles and those of the family members it added. A medical organization's patient records are seen and kept by that organization's owners and practitioners. Managers run the organization's members and settings but do not see patient information. A practitioner who leaves an organization can no longer see its patients. Platform staff cannot open health records: they see only account names, emails, organization details and counts.
privacy.organizations: Patient records belong to the medical organization that keeps them: they stay with the organization when a practitioner leaves. The organization is responsible for obtaining the patient's consent and keeping the records accurate. A new organization's patient records open only after platform staff have verified it. To have your own patient record corrected or deleted, contact the clinic that treated you.
privacy.security: Connections are encrypted with HTTPS. Passwords are stored as one-way bcrypt hashes. Sensitive information — intake notes, the pulse table, clinical and calculation notes, national register number, phone and address — is stored encrypted in the database. Platform staff and every member of a medical organization use 2-step sign-in. An audit log records who opened or changed which record and when; it never contains the health information itself. Sign-in attempts are rate limited and sessions expire after 12 hours.
privacy.delete: In Settings, on the Privacy tab, you can download a copy of your data (a JSON file) and permanently delete your account. Family members' profiles are deleted on the Family page. Patient records are permanently deleted from the patient page by the organization's owner or by the practitioner who registered the patient. For questions about your data, contact the organization that keeps your records or the system administrator.
